messages:
Liam (Partnerships): Heads up team  NebulaGrid sent a bundle for their marketplace tile and SI integration sheet. Need quick review: logo treatments, one-sentence co-author blurb, customer quote reuse, and SI partner badge alignment.
Nora (Partner Ops): Dropped the package here: https://drive.redwood/partners/nebulagrid/pack_2026. Files: nebula_logo.ai, nebula_lockup_v2.svg, nebula_case_acme.pdf, si_integration_sheet.xlsx, nebula_brand_guidelines.pdf
Priya (Design): Opening brand PDF now. Primary issue: Nebula uses a gradient on their primary mark. Marketplace rules allow gradients but require a flat fallback for small icons (<=32px). We need a flat-color fallback SVG and a monochrome badge.
Sam (PMM): Also we need a short blurb for the marketplace listing. Nebula suggested: "Powered by NebulaGrid and Redwood Inference." Can we make that 1 line and add a 2-line co-authorship option for the dedicated listing?
Priya (Design): For the badge I can export: `nebula_badge_flat.svg`, `nebula_badge_mono.svg`, and `nebula_thumbnail_16x9_v1.jpg` with safe margins. Any tagline preference?
Sam (PMM): Draft 1-line: "High-throughput inference with NebulaGrid." 2-line co-authorship (optional): "In partnership with NebulaGrid
Optimized by Redwood Inference." Thoughts?
Diego (Legal): Quick flag on the case quote in nebula_case_acme.pdf  looks like the quote contains a name and a demo log excerpt. Need to confirm Acme's release scope. If it's included in the case PDF and we have a signed consent, it's usually fine. Upload any signed release separately.
Nora (Partner Ops): I see `acme_release_signed_2026.pdf` in the folder. Uploaded by Nebula's partner rep at 09:12.
Diego (Legal): Ok I'll verify the signature and the scope. If the release is narrow (press-only) we might need an addendum for marketplace use. ETA a few hours.
Priya (Design): For accessibility: Nebula's colours are low contrast on dark BG. I'll provide an accessible variant: white-on-dark and dark-on-light badges. Filenames: `nebula_badge_light.png`, `nebula_badge_dark.png`. Adding `alt_text_en.md` with recommended alt text and localization notes.
Sam (PMM): For the marketplace thumbnail we need a short caption under the image and alt text. Caption proposal: "NebulaGrid + Redwood 3x throughput for batch inference'"  need to be careful with claims. Maybe: "NebulaGrid + Redwood: optimized inference for scale."
Liam (Partnerships): Use the conservative caption. No throughput claims unless benchmark docs are attached. Also confirm logos are used per Nebula's guidelines (no re-coloring, etc.).
Priya (Design): I'll add a small README in the folder with do/don't examples. Snippet included: ```Do: keep Nebula mark intact. Do: use flat fallback for small sizes. Don't: recolor internal star element. Spacing: 24px clearspace min.```
OnboardingBot: Reminder: partner-assets-checklist assigned to @Priya due in 48h
Nora (Partner Ops): Nebula asked about the SI partner lock — they want the "Certified Integration" badge next to the logos. Our policy: we can show Redwood "Verified SI" badge if partner meets checklist. Need confirmation from Solutions Eng first.
Sam (PMM): Can we show a muted "Integration partner" text line instead while the badge is pending? Something like: "Integration partner: NebulaGrid" under the product bullets.
Diego (Legal): That's fine as long as wording doesn't imply certification. Use "Integration partner" or "SI integration with NebulaGrid" not "Certified" unless verified by Solutions Eng.
Liam (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Priya export flat and mono badges + README + alt_text (Priya) 2) Sam finalize 1-line and 2-line blurb and thumbnail caption (Sam) 3) Diego confirm consent scope (Diego) 4) Solutions Eng badge check (Liam to ping) 5) Nora to collect final art and publish files named per our convention.
Priya (Design): Working on exports now. ETA 90m. I'll commit files as `partner-nebula-badge_flat.svg`, `partner-nebula-badge_mono.svg`, `partner-nebula-thumbnail_v1.jpg`, and `nebula_alt_text_en.md`.
Sam (PMM): I'll refine the blurb to: 1-line: "Optimized inference with NebulaGrid." 2-line: "In partnership with NebulaGrid
Built on Redwood Inference." Uploading marketing copy to the folder.
Diego (Legal): Reviewed `acme_release_signed_2026.pdf`  scope includes "marketing, web, and third-party marketplaces" signed by Acme legal. Legal OK to reuse quote with attribution. I'll add a one-liner to the README: "Acme release on 2026-07-02 permits reuse with attribution: AcmeCorp."
Nora (Partner Ops): Noted. Nebula just messaged that their localization manager will add translated alt text after we publish. Recommend we leave an `alt_text_locales/` placeholder.
Priya (Design): Added `alt_text_locales/placeholder.txt` with instructions: "Partners may add localized alt text; maintain canonical English in `nebula_alt_text_en.md`."
Liam (Partnerships): Good. Last item  file naming. Use our naming scheme: `partner-<partner>-<asset>_v1.<ext>` so we can track updates. Priya/Nora please confirm before final publish.
Priya (Design): Confirmed. Uploading now.
OnboardingBot: Task complete: assets-upload by @Priya. Next reminder: publish-ready-review in 24h for partners/nebulagrid/thread/2061234567
Sam (PMM): Will queue marketplace submission after Solutions Eng verifies integration badge. If badge not ready, we'll still submit tile with "Integration partner" copy and both light/dark badges.
Liam (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll ping Solutions Eng for the badge and update the thread when they reply.
